title: 🛫 Experience the Speed of the MiG-25PD in MSFS! 🌟
description:
Take to the skies with the legendary MiG-25PD ‘Foxbat,’ now available for Microsoft Flight Simulator! 🛩️ This high-speed interceptor, developed by the Soviet Union, features a powerful twin-engine setup capable of reaching speeds over Mach 2.8. With its advanced Smerch-A2 radar and a loadout of R-40 and R-60 missiles, the MiG-25PD is designed for high-altitude interception and reconnaissance missions. Experience the thrill of flying this iconic aircraft, complete with 4K PBR textures and custom animations. Don’t miss out on adding this Cold War legend to your MSFS hangar! ✈️✨

For a full overview of new aircrafts and liveries added to the marketplace this week have a look at the video below:
